properties.bedrock_type: Carboniferous Sandstone (Craigleith and Hailes Formations) and sedimentary siltstones interbedded with volcanic dolerite sills
properties.mineralogy: Quartz arenite with iron-oxide and silica cementation
properties.drainage: Urban subterranean drainage channeled along historic glacial drumlin slope toward the Firth of Forth basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Tarmacadam multi-lane carriageway with cast asphalt, dressed whinstone and granite kerbing, and Yorkstone / Caithness flagstone pedestrian pavements
properties.wear_characteristics: Crisp painted road markings ('KEEP CLEAR', center divider dashed lines), surface micro-aggregate exposure, damp gutter channels
properties.micro_grading: Gentle northeast descent along York Place alignment

properties.groundcover: Urban paved environment with occasional courtyard moss colonization along shaded sandstone plinths and masonry reveals

properties.primary_building_typology: Georgian New Town Ashlar Sandstone Terraces & Rear Infill Masonry Blocks

structures.name: York Place Georgian Terraced Tenements (Foreground/Primary Row)
structures.roof_geometry: Mansard and pitched roofs clad in Scottish Ballachulish slate with regular gabled dormer windows, stone chimney stacks, and clay chimney pots
structures.facade_material: Fine-grained Craigleith blonde ashlar sandstone with rusticated basement/ground levels and channelled ashlar joints
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced dark carbon soot crusting and historical industrial coal smoke patina across cornice undercuts, window reveals, and pedimented architraves

structures.name: Corner Return Pavilion / East Block
structures.roof_geometry: Mansard slate roof with dual-pitch slate hips and parapet coping
structures.facade_material: Blonde ashlar sandstone with painted timber ground-floor pilasters and timber sash-and-case windows
structures.weathering_patina: Moderate atmospheric grime, rain-washed facade panels contrasting with soot-stained stringcourses

structures.name: Rear Infill Courtyard Structure (Terracotta/Red Harled Block)
structures.roof_geometry: Flat felt/bitumen membrane roof with low parapets
structures.facade_material: Terracotta-red painted lime harling / rendered brickwork with white painted window frames
structures.weathering_patina: Faded pigmented wash with biological rain streaks and minor edge efflorescence

structures.name: Rear Industrial/Commercial Workshops & Outbuildings
structures.roof_geometry: Shallow gabled standing-seam zinc and corrugated composite roofs with large central skylights
structures.facade_material: Rubble sandstone and red engineering brick rear elevations
